description: Fetch one directory tool's full record by slug: description, DP pick (if any), jurisdiction, encryption, PII requirements, platforms, and its Default Privacy page (dp_url). Also returns `sources` (links, keyed by the field they back, with the date checked) and `caveats` (things to know before choosing). A null field means Default Privacy has not checked it (never read null as no); quote the caveats and cite the sources. Slugs come from dp_search_tools.
name: dp_get_tool
title: Get one privacy tool
